title: Right unitality of the normalized scalar comparison
statement: For every commutative ring map A→B, scheme T, and K in the ordinary small-etale derived A-module category, the normalized tensor and unit comparisons of [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations] satisfy δ_{K,1}(1⊗e)ρ=S(ρ_K). SiteScalarRightUnitLaw states this equation with shared site monoidal parameters.

source.place: Compatibility (3), Right unitality of the normalized scalar comparison

proof.text: On every K-flat complex the scalar representative is invertible. Apply representative right unitality to the all-complex tensor and unit normalization equations.

Both sides form natural transformations. Localization extensionality and a K-flat resolution of every complex extend the identity to every derived object. The site tensor comparison is the very same uniquely normalized comparison.
A proved private component accessor evaluates the shared-site normalization predicate at a derived object, keeping the site monoidal structures abstract.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility (3), tensor and mixed Cartesian squares.

    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)

      (scalarExtension φ T) (tensorIso φ T) (unitIso φ T)
